title: TRIALMON safety review console
summary: A one-screen safety review of a synthetic first-in-human multiple ascending dose study, CP-101, at its Cohort 4 (120 mg) data cut with 18 dosed participants. Participant, cohort and study-level flags roll up worst-of into one ranked worklist, beside an eDISH liver plot, QTcF categories, CTCAE lab shifts, adverse events by system organ class, a DLT tally against an illustrative 3+3 rule and a study tier with a what-if. A Start here card inside the app says what each color means. The console flags positions for the medical monitor and the Safety Review Committee; it does not adjudicate cases or make a dose-escalation decision.
try: Click CP101-004's row (the first AMBER) in the worklist: the sidebar packet switches to CP101-004, and the line above the worklist says which participant is open.

Open Liver (eDISH): two points sit in the shaded box. Click CP101-014 (potential Hy's Law), then CP101-004 (its TBL peaked 18 days before its ALT, so not Hy's Law), and compare their liver tests by study day.
Switch Lab grading to v5.0 in the sidebar: CP101-013's neutrophil count becomes grade 3 and the AMBER count rises from 7 to 8.
On Study tier, set an indicator to RED: the study tier turns RED, and Reset to the feed undoes it.

screenshot.alt: The TRIALMON console as it opens: the packet for participant CP101-014 (RED) in the sidebar; the Start here card with what the console shows, every rule behind RED, AMBER and watch, and four things to try; seven value boxes (overall RED, participants and cohorts RED, study tier AMBER, 5 RED and 7 AMBER flags, 2 watch, 18 dosed participants); and the top of the ranked worklist.
screenshot.caption: The console as it opens: the Start here card, the worst-of value boxes and the ranked worklist. It follows the site's light or dark theme. Synthetic data.
